JUDGE BURST N9-jdg-02 — the Necromancer's turnaround, OWNER-CHECKLIST pass (Run C-6 P2): every item below was a defect the owner found in the previous pass; verify each by looking, not by claim. task_id "N9-jdg-02". You are a separate instance: you have not seen any prompt, receipt, check or prior judgment, and must not look for one.

Image 1 is the owner's master at full resolution — read the INVARIANTS from it: PALE ICE-BLUE eyes; a ROUND PLAIN SILVER belt disc with a small leaf-like sigil (NO skull); a POLISHED SILVER-STEEL ribcage relief on a black cuirass (metal, not bone); ONE bone horn on HIS LEFT shoulder, nothing on the right; a small dark-leather TOME at his LEFT hip with SILVER CORNER CAPS and a short RED RIBBON marker, no other emblem; a war scythe in EXACTLY TWO gauntleted hands, HELD OUT IN FRONT of him (haft away from the chest, upper hand extended at shoulder height); NO skull anywhere on him. Image 2 is the same master at the scene camera: an elevated view looking DOWN ~53° (crown and shoulder tops seen from above, feet foreshortened) at cell scale — the camera and scale every candidate must match.
GEOMETRY RULE (sides): turned toward screen-RIGHT he shows his RIGHT side — the BLADE over the near shoulder; toward screen-LEFT his LEFT side — HORN + TOME near, blade behind the far shoulder; back views: blade SCREEN-RIGHT of the head, horn SCREEN-LEFT. Wrong sides for the claim = MIRRORED. Judge each candidate independently; do not assume any is a control or correct.

Image 3 claims NW. EXPECTED for NW: a BACK three-quarter view — he faces the viewer's UPPER-LEFT, turned 135° from the S pose, walking away from the camera toward screen-left. His BACK and his LEFT side are toward the camera: the HORN on his left shoulder stands on the SCREEN-LEFT, nearer the camera; the TOME hangs at his left hip on the screen-left; long bone-white hair falls down his back. The scythe is held two-handed IN FRONT of his body, so from behind the haft is HIDDEN by the torso except where it emerges above his far RIGHT shoulder on the SCREEN-RIGHT (the BLADE rising there, its tip the highest point, hooking outward away from the head) and below his left hip on the screen-left (the butt spike). His hands are in front of him and mostly hidden — at most a gauntlet edge shows at his side; NEVER hands or arms bent behind his back. Face NOT visible (at most the edge of the cheek); back of the cuirass and pauldrons seen.
Image 4 claims SE. EXPECTED for SE: he is turned 45° toward SCREEN-RIGHT from the S pose — body, chest and head all face the viewer's LOWER-RIGHT. His RIGHT side is nearer the camera: the haft is on the near side, rising from low at his far LEFT hip across the front of his chest up past his near RIGHT shoulder on the SCREEN-LEFT; the BLADE rises above and beyond the near right shoulder on the screen-left, tip the highest point, hooking outward away from the head. The HORN rises from his far LEFT shoulder on the SCREEN-RIGHT beyond his head; the TOME hangs at the far left hip on the screen-right, partly behind the body. Face visible in three-quarter view, the head turned WITH the body toward the screen's lower-right — not tilted, not turned back toward screen-left — level, eyes on the horizon.
Image 5 claims N. EXPECTED for N: a full BACK view — he faces directly AWAY from the camera (his back to the viewer). His RIGHT side is on the SCREEN-RIGHT. The scythe is held two-handed IN FRONT of his body: from behind the haft is HIDDEN by the torso except above his RIGHT shoulder on the SCREEN-RIGHT, where the BLADE stands, tip the highest point, and below his LEFT hip on the screen-left, where the butt spike shows. His hands are in front of him and hidden by his body — NEVER hands or arms behind his back. The HORN rises from his LEFT shoulder on the SCREEN-LEFT; the TOME at his left hip is on the screen-left. Long bone-white hair covers the upper back; back of the cuirass, both pauldrons and the split skirt seen from behind; the back of the head only, no face.
Image 6 claims SE. EXPECTED for SE: he is turned 45° toward SCREEN-RIGHT from the S pose — body, chest and head all face the viewer's LOWER-RIGHT. His RIGHT side is nearer the camera: the haft is on the near side, rising from low at his far LEFT hip across the front of his chest up past his near RIGHT shoulder on the SCREEN-LEFT; the BLADE rises above and beyond the near right shoulder on the screen-left, tip the highest point, hooking outward away from the head. The HORN rises from his far LEFT shoulder on the SCREEN-RIGHT beyond his head; the TOME hangs at the far left hip on the screen-right, partly behind the body. Face visible in three-quarter view, the head turned WITH the body toward the screen's lower-right — not tilted, not turned back toward screen-left — level, eyes on the horizon.

For EACH candidate write the CHECKLIST as booleans, each with one line of visible evidence:
eyes_blue (pale blue irises visible; if the face is hidden write null) · head_level (HARD: the face is NOT angled toward the ground at all — chin level or fractionally raised, eyes on the horizon; any downward bow = false; if the face is hidden judge from the skull/hair angle) · head_aligned (not tilted sideways, not turned against the body) · no_skull_buckle · no_skull_shoulder · no_skull_book · ribcage_steel (silver metal, not bone/ivory; null if the back is shown) · tome_master_ornament (corner caps + red ribbon, nothing else; null if hidden) · hands_exactly_two (exactly two gauntlets, both on the haft, none emerging from the torso or floating) · hands_in_front (back views: no arms bent behind the back; null for front views) · scythe_held_out (HARD: the scythe is HELD OUT IN FRONT as in Image 1 — the haft stands away from the chest, the upper hand extended forward/outward at about shoulder height; a haft resting against the torso or hugged to the chest = false) · buckle_detail (the round silver belt disc with its small sigil is clearly drawn; a blank or smeared disc = false; null if hidden) · standing_upright (HARD: an at-ease STANDING rest — legs straight, feet under the hips, torso upright, no crouch, no wide fighting stance, no forward lean) · camera_matches (crown/shoulder tops seen from above and feet foreshortened as in Image 2 — not eye-level, not shallower) · scale_matches (sole-to-crown height the same fraction of the canvas as Image 2, ±10 %) · mirrored (sides swapped for the claim) · seen_facing.
Then axes 1–5 (integers, one-line reasons): 1 register · 2 identity (count the checklist falses) · 3 light (key screen upper-left) · 4 equipment geometry vs EXPECTED (all correct = 5; each error −1; mirrored = 1) · 5 direction read at 64 px.
Write out/judgment.json: {"candidates":[{"image":n,"claimed":"…","seen_facing":"…","checklist":{"eyes_blue":bool|null,"head_level":bool,"head_aligned":bool,"no_skull_buckle":bool,"no_skull_shoulder":bool,"no_skull_book":bool,"ribcage_steel":bool|null,"tome_master_ornament":bool|null,"hands_exactly_two":bool,"hands_in_front":bool|null,"scythe_held_out":bool,"buckle_detail":bool|null,"standing_upright":bool,"camera_matches":bool,"scale_matches":bool},"evidence":{"head_level":"…",…},"mirrored":bool,"axes":{"1":n,…},"reasons":{"4":"…",…}}, …]}. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used must be 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "N9-jdg-02"; images []; files [out/judgment.json + sha256]; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns for anything you could not assess. Never PASS/FAIL — booleans and scores only.
